# Settlement agreement

*Without prejudice and subject to contract*

**Claim number:** ⟦CASE|6001842/2026⟧ (Employment Tribunal, Bristol)

## Parties

1. **⟦ORG|Harrow & Finch Ltd⟧**, of ⟦ADDRESS|7 Coopers Yard, Bristol BS1 9ZX⟧ (the Employer).
2. **Ms ⟦PERSON|Maya Bennett⟧**, of ⟦ADDRESS|Flat 3, 41 Larch Road, Bristol BS6 9ZY⟧, born ⟦DATE|14 March 1988⟧, National Insurance number ⟦IDENTITY|QQ 12 34 56 C⟧ (the Employee).

## Background

Ms ⟦PERSON|Bennett⟧, known to colleagues as ⟦PERSON|Mia⟧, was employed by ⟦ORG|Harrow & Finch Ltd⟧ as a Senior Analyst from 2 May 2019 until 30 September 2026. ⟦PERSON|Maya⟧ brought the claim above, alleging unfair dismissal. ⟦ORG|Harrow & Finch Ltd⟧ denies the claim. The parties have agreed to settle it on the terms below.

## Terms

1. **Payment.** ⟦ORG|Harrow & Finch Ltd⟧ will pay Ms ⟦PERSON|Bennett⟧ £18,500 as compensation for loss of employment within 14 days of receiving this agreement signed by her and her adviser.
2. **Reference.** The Employer will provide a reference in agreed wording on request.
3. **Withdrawal.** Ms ⟦PERSON|Bennett⟧ will withdraw the claim within seven days of receiving the payment.
4. **Confidentiality.** Ms ⟦PERSON|Bennett⟧ will keep the terms of this agreement confidential, except that she may disclose them to her husband, ⟦PERSON|Daniel Bennett⟧, to her professional advisers and as required by law.
5. **Return of property.** Ms ⟦PERSON|Bennett⟧'s laptop, security pass and any documents belonging to the Employer will be returned by 31 October 2026.

| Item | Amount | Due |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Compensation | £18,500 | 14 days after signature |
| Legal fees contribution | £750 | 14 days after signature |

## Independent advice

Ms ⟦PERSON|Bennett⟧ has received advice from ⟦PERSON|Priya Shah⟧ of ⟦ORG|Elm Row Legal LLP⟧ on the terms and effect of this agreement.
